title: Friend sees a portal open in the sky and saucers fly out
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Friend sees a portal open in the sky and saucers fly out, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: a portal open up in the sky and saucers fly out of it like what my friend saw. My my friend saw this actually happen

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says a friend of his actually saw a portal, a kind of opening, appear in the sky, with saucer-shaped craft flying out of it. No time or place is given. If true, it would mean these craft come through doorways from somewhere else rather than flying in from space.
